comment: The principle of local capacity is strong, but it would be more actionable if linked to a structured national capacity-development approach. Short project-based training is insufficient to build and retain architecture, FHIR, terminology, security and governance capability.

anchor.note: p.33 l.304–322 read as the printed page; section 2.3 agrees

public.text: The principle of local capacity is strong, but it would be more actionable if linked to a structured national capacity-development approach. Short project-based training is insufficient to build and retain architecture, FHIR, terminology, security and governance capability.
public.suggestedRevision: Recommend national programmes combining competency assessment, practical training, mentoring, certification pathways, communities of practice and retention measures. Encourage partnerships among governments, universities, civil society, professional associations and regional networks, with progressive transfer of responsibilities from external consultants to national teams.
